vulnerability_analysis: The TokenTool contract has owner-only functions that can blacklist addresses via multipleBotlistAddress. The owner privilege can be abused to arbitrarily blacklist any address, which violates the intended access control.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call multipleBotlistAddress to blacklist the victim address.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the owner address from the contract
2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner
3. Call multipleBotlistAddress([victim], true) to blacklist the victim
4. Verify _isBlacklisted[victim] == true
